label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 124

obligations.text:
Data protection and journalism code
(1)
The Commission must prepare a code of practice which contains—
(a)
practical guidance in relation to the processing of personal data for the purposes of journalism in accordance with the requirements of the data protection legislation, and
(b)
such other guidance as the Commission considers appropriate to promote good practice in the processing of personal data for the purposes of journalism.

(3)
Before preparing a code or amendments under this section, the Commission must consult such of the following as the Commission considers appropriate—
(a)
trade associations;
